section13_checks.prohibition_description: Grant Agreement Annex / Model Grant Agreement Annex / AGA template used as a governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Invented call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not traceable to Tier 2B.
Invented project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, objectives, prior experience, figures) not traceable to Tier 3.
Phase 8 activity / budget-dependent content produced before the budget gate (Phase 7) passes.
Durable decisions held only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
A skill or workflow becoming a de facto constitutional authority by expanding scope.
Silent phase reordering or dependence on outputs from a phase higher than the artifact's own phase.
Finalising text with incomplete/unresolved source state without explicitly flagging the gap in the deliverable.

Using generic programme knowledge of Horizon Europe rules (participation conditions, grant agreement terms, financial regulation) as a substitute for a Tier 1 source when a regulatory claim is asserted.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: Sub-section 2.2 asserts a grant-agreement IP rule: "As a single-beneficiary MSCA postdoctoral fellowship, FIELDWISE carries no bespoke consortium IP arithmetic, and the default position applies: results are owned by the host, ELTE, with the fellow as author-inventor". This grant-agreement-terms claim (claim_id IPR_DEFAULT_STRATEGY) carries source_ref to Tier 4 (phase5_impact_architecture) only; the artifact's traceability_footer.primary_sources[] contains no path within docs/tier1_normative_framework/extracted/. A regulatory/grant-agreement claim carries no Tier 1 source reference.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Tier 5 outputs not traceable to Tier 1–4 inputs.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.
